about: The reference Met-A and the C-Score read against: purified healthy cell arrays, at Met-A's 6,000 neutrophil identity sites only, so it is drawn as dots, each at the same place as on the atlas globes. A blood sample is compared with these profiles mixed in its own proportions. IAM-Atlas v2.1 is a different reference, built from 21 sources over the whole genome; the two agree closely value by value.
